notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
[h3]Modified curve of gold income, to allow more gold beginning of the game[/h3]

[h3]Modified health of enemies depending on their level[/h3]
[list]
[*]Enemies start with less health than before
[*]Enemies win more health per minute
[*]Enemies end the game with more health than before
[/list]

[h3]Slight adjustment of timing for the tutorial[/h3]
